sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1119993_geobarkr.geoBarkrAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>geoBarkrAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var geoBarkrAjax = Class.create();
geoBarkrAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    getDistanceFromLongLats: function() {
		// Get params
		var longlat1 = JSON.parse(this.getParameter('sysparm_longlat1'));
		var longlat2 = JSON.parse(this.getParameter('sysparm_longlat2'));

		// Get calculation and return
		var calc = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return calc.calculateDistanceBetweenPoints(longlat1.lng, longlat1.lat, longlat2.lng, longlat2.lat);
    },
	getViewDetailsFromGame: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');

		// Get location details and return
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.getCurrentViewfromGame(gameID);
	},
	nextRound: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');

		// Get location details and return
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.nextRound(gameID);
	},
	createGuess: function() {
		var distance = this.getParameter('sysparm_distance');
		var lat = this.getParameter('sysparm_lat');
		var lng = this.getParameter('sysparm_lng');
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');
		var userID = gs.getUserID();

		// Create guess record with calculations
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.createGuess(gameID, userID, distance, lat, lng);
	},
	checkIfNextRound: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');
		var multiplayer = this.getParameter('sysparm_multiplayer') === 'true';

		// Check if next round available in this game
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.checkIfNextRound(gameID, multiplayer);
	},
	getUserGameGuesses: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');
		var userID = gs.getUserID();

		// Get guess details for user from utils
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.getUserGameGuesses(gameID, userID);
	},
	startMultiGame: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');

		// Initialise new multiplayer game
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.startMultiGame(gameID);
	},
	completeGame: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');

		// Complete a game
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.completeGame(gameID);
	},
    type: 'geoBarkrAjax'
});

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GeoBarkrUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var GeoBarkrUtils = Class.create();
GeoBarkrUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},
    calculateDistanceBetweenPoints: function(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2) {
        // Convert degrees to radians
        function toRad(value) {
            return value * Math.PI / 180;
        }

        var R = 6371; // Radius of the Earth in km
        var dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
        var dLng = toRad(lng2 - lng1);

        var a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
            Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) *
            Math.sin(dLng / 2) * Math.sin(dLng / 2);

        var c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));

        var distanceKm = R * c; // Distance in km

        // Round
        var rounded = 0.0;
        if (distanceKm >= 10) {
            rounded = Math.round(distanceKm); // nearest integer
        } else {
            rounded = Math.round(distanceKm * 10) / 10; // round to 1 dp
        }
        return rounded.toString();
    },
    generatePlayers: function(gameID, players) {
        // Generates player records for a game with GameID for each player with a sys_id in players list

        // Check valid game
        if (this._checkValidGame(gameID)) {
            var gamePlayers = [];

            players.forEach(function(playerID, index) {
                // Get user record
                var player = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
                if (player.get(playerID.toString())) {

                    // Initialise game player record
                    var gamePlayer = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game_player');
                    gamePlayer.initialize();

                    // Set fields
                    gamePlayer.player = player.getValue('sys_id');
                    gamePlayer.game = gameID;
                    gamePlayer.total_distance = 0;
                    gamePlayer.total_score = 0;

                    // Add sys_id to array of gamePlayer records
                    gamePlayers.push(gamePlayer.insert());
                }
            });

            // Return array of sys_ids of gameplayer records
            return gamePlayers;
        }
    },
    generateRounds: function(gameID, launch) {
        // Generates rounds from a map for a game with ID gameID. If launch is true, will start first round

        // Check valid game
        if (this._checkValidGame(gameID)) {

            var game = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game');
            if (game.get(gameID)) {

                // Get locations from map
                var location = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_location');
                location.addQuery('map', game.getValue('map').toString());
                location.query();

                // Generate a round for each location in map
                while (location.next()) {
                    var round = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
                    round.initialize();

                    // Add info to round
                    round.game = gameID;
                    round.round_number = location.u_round_number;
                    round.location = location.sys_id;

                    // Initialise first round
                    if (launch == 'true' && location.u_round_number == '1') {
                        round.status = '2';
                        round.round_started = new GlideDateTime();
                    }

                    // Insert round
                    round.insert();
                }
                return 100;
            }
        }
    },
    getCurrentViewfromGame: function(gameID) {

        // Find current in play round
        var round = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        round.addQuery('game', gameID);
        round.addQuery('status', 'IN', '2,21');
        round.query();

        // Get location from round
        if (round.next()) {
            var location = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_location');
            if (location.get(round.location.sys_id)) {

                return JSON.stringify({
                    lng: location.getValue('lng'),
                    lat: location.getValue('lat'),
                    heading: location.getValue('heading'),
                    pitch: location.getValue('pitch')
                });
            }
        }
        return '400';
    },
    nextRound: function(gameID) {
        // Completes current round and puts next round in play

        // Complete current round
        var currentRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        currentRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
        currentRound.addQuery('status', 'IN', '2,21'); // In progress or results round
        currentRound.query();

        if (currentRound.next()) {
            currentRound.status = '3'; // Complete
            currentRound.round_ended = new GlideDateTime();
            currentRound.update();

            // Get existing round number
            var oldRoundNumber = parseInt(currentRound.getValue('round_number'));
            var newRoundNumStr = String(oldRoundNumber + 1);

            // Look for next round
            var newRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
            newRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
            newRound.addQuery('status', '1'); // Ready
            newRound.addQuery('round_number', newRoundNumStr); // Next round in map
            newRound.query();

            if (newRound.next()) {
                newRound.status = '2';
                newRound.round_started = new GlideDateTime();
                newRound.update();
                return '100';
            }

        }
        return 'test from SI';
    },
    createGuess: function(gameID, userID, distance, lat, lng) {
        // Creates guess record for given data. Calculates time spent on round.

        if (this._checkValidGame(gameID)) {
            // Get game player sys_id
            var gamePlayerID = this._getGamePlayer(gameID, userID);

            // Get current round
            var currentRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
            currentRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
            currentRound.addQuery('status', '2'); // In progress round
            currentRound.query();
            if (currentRound.next()) {

                // Initialise guess
                var guess = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_guess');
                guess.initialize();


                // Calculate time taken
                var roundStart = new GlideDateTime(currentRound.getValue('round_started').toString());
                var now = new GlideDateTime();
                var guess_time = GlideDateTime.subtract(roundStart, now);


                // Set fields
                guess.round = currentRound.getValue('sys_id');
                guess.lon = lng;
                guess.lat = lat;
                guess.player = gamePlayerID;
                guess.distance = distance;
                guess.guess_time = guess_time;

                // Insert
                return guess.insert();
            }
        }
        return '404';
    },
    checkIfNextRound: function(gameID, multiplayer) {
        // Checks if a game with gameID has a valid next round

        var isNextRound = 'false';

        // Get next round
        var nextRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        nextRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
        if (multiplayer) {
            nextRound.addQuery('status', 'IN', '1,2'); // A round is ready or in progress
        } else {
			nextRound.addQuery('status', '1'); // A round is ready
		}

        nextRound.query();
        if (nextRound.next()) {
            isNextRound = 'true';
        }
        return isNextRound;
    },
    getUserGameGuesses: function(gameID, userID) {
        // Returns list of JSONs of guesses for user from given game
        var guesses = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_guess');
        guesses.addQuery('round.game', gameID);
        guesses.addQuery('player.player', userID);
        guesses.orderBy('round.round_number');
        guesses.query();

        var guessList = [];
        while (guesses.next()) {
            // Get formatted time
            var timeFormatted = this._formatTimeField(guesses.getValue('guess_time'));
            var timeRaw = new GlideDateTime(guesses.getValue('guess_time')).getNumericValue()

            guessList.push({

                num: guesses.round.round_number.getValue(),
                distance: guesses.getValue('distance'),
                score: guesses.getValue('score'),
                time: timeFormatted,
                lng: guesses.getValue('lon'),
                lat: guesses.getValue('lat'),
                targetLat: guesses.round.location.lat.getValue(),
                targetLng: guesses.round.location.lng.getValue(),
                timeRaw: timeRaw / 1000

            });
        }
        return JSON.stringify(guessList);
    },
    getGamePlayers(gameID) {
        // Returns list of JSONs of info for players in current game
        var playerList = [];
        var players = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game_player');
        players.addQuery('game', gameID);
        players.query();

        while (players.next()) {
            playerList.push({
                name: players.getDisplayValue('player'),
                time_joined: players.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on'),
                userName: players.player.user_name.toString()
            });
        }
        return playerList;

    },
    startMultiGame: function(gameID) {
        // Changes game to in play and starts first round
        var game = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game');
        if (game.get(gameID)) {
            game.setValue('status', 2);
            game.update();
        }

        // Start first round
        var round = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        round.addQuery('game', gameID);
        round.addQuery('round_number', '1');
        round.query();

        if (round.next()) {
            round.status = '2';
            round.round_started = new GlideDateTime();
            round.update();
        }
        return '404';
    },
    getRoundGuesses: function(gameID) {
        // Returns list of JSONs of guesses to current round
        var currentRoundID = this.getCurrentRoundID(gameID);

        // Get guesses
        var guesses = [];
        var guess = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_guess');
        guess.addQuery('round', currentRoundID);
        guess.query();

        while (guess.next()) {
            guesses.push({
                player: guess.player.player.getValue(),
                playerName: guess.player.player.getDisplayValue(),
                lng: guess.getValue('lon'),
                lat: guess.getValue('lat'),
                time: this._formatTimeField(guess.getValue('guess_time')),
				distance: guess.getValue('distance')
            });
        }

        return guesses;
    },
    getCurrentRoundID: function(gameID) {
        // Returns ID of current round in game with gameID
        var currentRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        currentRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
        currentRound.addQuery('status', 'IN', '2,21'); // A round is in play or results status
        currentRound.query();
        if (currentRound.next()) {
            return currentRound.sys_id;
        }
        return '404';
    },
    sendRoundtoResults: function(roundID) {
        // Sends status of given round to results
        var round = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        if (round.get(roundID)) {
            round.status = 21;
            round.update();
        }
    },
    getRoundNumber: function(gameID) {
        // Returns round number of current game
        var round = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        if (round.get(this.getCurrentRoundID(gameID))) {
            return parseInt(round.round_number);
        }

    },
	completeGame: function(gameID) {
		// Completes game
		if (this._checkValidGame(gameID)) {
			var game = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game');
			if(game.get(gameID)) {
				// Complete game
				game.setValue('status', '3');
				game.update();

				// Complete rounds
				var openRounds = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
				openRounds.addQuery('game', gameID);
				openRounds.addQuery('status', '!=', '3'); // Only look for rounds not complete
				openRounds.query();

				while (openRounds.next()) {
					openRounds.setValue('status', 3);
					openRounds.setValue('round_ended', new GlideDateTime());
					openRounds.update();
				}
				return '200';
			}
		}
	},
    _checkValidGame: function(gameID) {
        // Checks if ID is of an active game record (status is lobby or in play)

        var game = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game');
        game.addQuery('status', 'IN', '1,2'); // Lobby or In play
        game.addQuery('sys_id', gameID);
        game.query();

        if (game.next()) {
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    },
    _getGamePlayer: function(gameID, userID) {
        // Returns sys_id of gamePlayer record for gameID game and userID user
        var gamePlayer = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game_player');
        gamePlayer.addQuery('player', userID);
        gamePlayer.addQuery('game', gameID);
        gamePlayer.query();

        if (gamePlayer.next()) {
            return gamePlayer.getValue('sys_id');
        }


    },
    _formatTimeField: function(timeStr) {
        // Formats time GDT into mins and secs
        var gdt = new GlideDateTime(timeStr);
        var date = new Date(gdt.getNumericValue());
        var mins = date.getUTCMinutes();

        var formattedTime = date.getUTCSeconds() + 's';
        if (mins != '0') {
            formattedTime = date.getUTCMinutes() + 'min ' + formattedTime;
        }
        return formattedTime;
    },
    type: 'GeoBarkrUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-10 23:54:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>7e0d13aa93de76100fa17bfdfaba10be</sys_id><sys_mod_count>73</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GeoBarkrUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GeoBarkr" source="x_1119993_geobarkr">a4e2616e93de36100fa17bfdfaba1042</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="GeoBarkr">a4e2616e93de36100fa17bfdfaba1042</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7e0d13aa93de76100fa17bfdfaba10be</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-28 22:27:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
